The symptoms of a pruritic rash appearing after a period of low-grade fever, rhinorrhea, and headache are characteristic of Roseola, which is caused by Human Herpesvirus 6 or 7. Please confirm if you or your child recently had a high fever that resolved before the rash appeared.
